cases.evidence: Cambridge's published scheme prints the template placeholder '9702/COMP' on its cover and every page header instead of 9702/22. The cover otherwise reads PHYSICS, Paper 2 AS Level Structured Questions, March 2021, Maximum Mark: 60. March has a single Paper 2 variant (22); the question paper's footers all read 9702/22/F/M/21, and the scheme's mark tokens sum to 60, the question paper's printed total. Reviewed in the 9702 content workspace (data/identity-review-cases.json, 2026-11-17) and re-checked from the rendered covers 2026-11-20.
cases.proposedRule: Individual exception keyed by bank/paper plus BOTH PDF SHA-256 hashes; the '9702/COMP' placeholder is accepted only for this 9702/22 March 2021 pair.
